## 💖 What does this Pull Request do? (Give us the lowdown!)

A clear and concise description of the changes you've made.
(e.g., "This PR adds a new feature that makes Ushka purr when the server starts, making my cat very happy.")

---

## 🚀 How can we test this wonderful change?

Please describe the steps to test your changes. Include any special setup, commands, or routes to hit.

---

## ✅ Checklist (Because we love tidy submissions!)

Please check the boxes that apply (delete options that are not applicable).

- [ ] I have read the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/kleber-code/ushka/blob/main/.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project.
- [ ] My changes require a change to the documentation.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly.
- [ ] I have added tests to cover my changes.
- [ ] All new and existing tests passed.

---

## 📸 Screenshots (If applicable)

If your changes involve UI/UX, please include screenshots or GIFs here. We love pretty pictures!

---

## 💬 Anything else?

Add any other context or comments here. Thanks for making Ushka even better! 💖
